reason: A scheduling and monitoring plugin that runs Agent tasks on cron schedules, manages task state, enforces run timeouts, and displays local system and harness status.

summaries.zh: 按 cron 时间表自动执行 Agent 任务，并通过命令和设置页仪表盘管理任务及查看系统与 Harness 状态。
summaries.en: Schedules Agent tasks with cron timing and provides task management plus system and Harness status dashboards.

capabilities: Automatically launches Agent runs without user interaction at scheduled times
Executes task content using the current account permissions
Reads and writes task records and session logs on local storage
Provides process and harness status metrics through commands and a dashboard
Stops runs after a configurable timeout
